newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - December 26.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - December 26.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had no large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The high in natural float was a bit over $2.7 billion on Tuesday, while the low was about $950 million on Thursday.
Transportation float averaged at about $175 million per day, with the high on Tuesday at about $350 million primarily due to overfueling on a plane in New York.
